skill_name: Compare machine learning with artificial intelligence
workflow: Machine learning and artificial intelligence are two related fields of study that both focus on developing computer systems that can carry out tasks without being explicitly programmed. The two are related, but they are not interchangeable. Machine learning is focused on enabling machines to independently learn and improve on the data they are given, whereas artificial intelligence is focused on developing computer systems that can mimic human cognition.
